annotations.title: Pryx — Product offers and price history

description: Returns current merchant offers (best 5, in EUR, French market), the lowest price ever seen and a price-history summary for ONE product, identified by its EAN. Get the EAN from the `ean` field of pryx_advice results. Read-only. Use it to answer "where is it cheapest?" or "is it a good time to buy?" after a recommendation.
name: pryx_product
